body.statement: For every finite rational instance, the certified procedure enumerates at most \(A_{\max}=N!\,2^{N(N-1)/2+2^N-1}\) labeled source architectures, enumerates their deterministic response tables up to \(R_{\max}\), and expands the moment and essential-feature formulas coefficient by coefficient. Quantifier elimination reports INFEASIBLE or isolates the algebraic infimum and supremum of the bounded finite graph-legal image. At each isolated endpoint \(t\), it decides \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\). If true, \(\mathsf{Cert}(t)\) contains an algebraic \(T,p_T,\rho\) witness whose exact graph is verified by \(\Psi_{T,G}\). If false, \(\mathsf{Cert}(t)\) contains a finite family of sign-invariant cylindrical cells proving that every enumerated legal branch is empty, so the closure endpoint has no legal lift in any enumerated architecture. With parameter count \(p_{\mathrm{dim}}\), constraint count \(s_{\mathrm{count}}\), maximum degree \(D_{\mathrm{deg}}\), and expanded coefficient bit length \(\tau_{\mathrm{eff}}\), the arithmetic-operation bound is \(A_{\max}R_{\max}(s_{\mathrm{count}}D_{\mathrm{deg}})^{2^{O(p_{\mathrm{dim}})}}\operatorname{poly}(\tau_{\mathrm{eff}})\).
body.justification: The procedure produces checkable positive or negative legality certificates rather than restating attainment as existential feasibility.
body.gap: Duarte et al. optimize a compact fixed-graph parameterization but do not enumerate exact selected-MAG strata or certify that a boundary optimum is excluded from every legal architecture.
body.consumer: A clinical audit can distinguish an attained endpoint mechanism from a graph-deleting closure artifact and retain the certificate with the reported bound.
